answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fakes. Each agent burns 60 POA to claim one work slot for 20 epochs, like reserving a berth before a voyage. The slot is non-transferable and tied to one record, so a meadow of honest workers is not crowded out by clones. Faking 1,000 identities burns 60,000 POA, and idle copies in a lagoon of unworked slots expire earning nothing. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
